schedule_disposition: planned_only; this bounded pilot must not advance the last completed sweep date or alone enable the monthly schedule

candidate_decisions.name: GPN-Star
candidate_decisions.novelty: new to this archived catalogue, not a newly released project since its prior search cutoff

dedupe.identity_note: Official README lists PhyloGPN and GPN-Star separately. Sharing a repository does not establish identical model configurations. GPN-Star is already mentioned in the old pinned README but has no matching catalogue record.

candidate_decisions.source_locator: Primary article title/date and Data/Code availability; official README model comparison table and GPN-Star citation
candidate_decisions.decision_reason: In-scope genomic model candidate with identifiable primary paper and maintained official resources. Queue exact checkpoints, alignment versions, dataset/protocol extraction and source-table review; no measurements were imported.
blocked_on: Complete checkpoint and version identity reconciliation
Exact benchmark datasets, splits, controls, denominators and uncertainty extraction
Independent scientific applicability review and approval
candidate_decisions.relevance_limits: No clinical suitability, model winner or independent reproduction claim.

candidate_decisions.name: GlycoGym
candidate_decisions.novelty: already recorded as an unreviewed lead in search-discovery-other-omics on 2026-09-16
candidate_decisions.source_locator: README task overview, NMR notes and Zenodo section
candidate_decisions.decision_reason: Primary repository is accessible and describes glycan benchmark tasks and a versioned dataset landing page. Keep pending until task-level protocol, split and dataset-version checks are complete.
blocked_on: Dataset landing page and licences not inspected
NMR exclusion and source-overlap limitations require dedicated review

source_check_limits.reason: The existing script would perform 62 project-head requests; this pilot intentionally sampled two sources. Its discovery.jsonl/migrated.jsonl inventory excludes the GPN enriched source checked here.
source_check_limits.interpretation: Changed HEAD is a review lead, not proof of changed numerical evidence. Both pinned README hashes match recorded receipts and both current READMEs are byte-identical. The GPN repository changed elsewhere; its diff remains unreviewed.

use_case_review.method: Existing loadUseCases, buildUseCaseArtifact and validateUseCaseArtifact; read-only
use_case_review.mapping_fingerprints: compared without renewal against archived catalogue
limitations: Receipt and dependency checks do not re-review scientific applicability or clinical validity.
All comparisons use the archived baseline; unimported upstream changes cannot change its mapping fingerprints.
No reviewed_at values, scientific inputs, receipts or evidence hashes were changed.
use_case_review.monthly_age_rule: Older than one month from 2026-10-01; this age check is not proof of source freshness.

gaps: No complete lane sweep, publication-index pagination, checkpoint registry census or pending-candidate inventory screening.
Only two of 999 baseline source records were rechecked; one of the existing script's 62 eligible source records was sampled.
GPN changed HEAD requires a separate code/release diff review despite the unchanged README.
Corrections/retractions, comprehensive access/licence changes, broken-link coverage and contributor submissions were not swept.
All17 use cases retain explicit evidence gaps and automated review provenance; no scientific applicability, clinical suitability or human review was renewed.
The latest local archive was verified; live website/API/download release alignment was not checked in this pilot.

No content update PR, publication, release or benchmark execution was performed. A subsequent complete scoped manual sweep and named operational/scientific ownership remain prerequisites to activation.

evidence_artifacts.http_response_note: Exact README and GitHub API bytes are retained under sources/. The publisher HTML body was hashed but not redistributed; the primary page was read through web browsing and direct HTTP retrieval succeeded.
